name: Žerotín (Louny District, Czechia)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of white and green, the white bearing a black eagle with yellow beak and the green two crossed white candles above a white well.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 24 February 2011 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
